title: First projection pasting under shrinking the graph intersection
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, c a compactification of h:X→Z, H a proper/open/proper presentation of h, a′:X→W proper, and v:W→H.U open with a′v=H.a. Put S=H.shrink(a′,v,fac). For the explicit first legs L1_H,L1_S and the inverse intersection triangle K of [def-pur-etale-graph-shrink-intersection-words], and L=graphFirstShrinkIso of [def-pur-etale-graph-neighborhood-words], the natural transformations satisfy L1_H.hom≫K.hom=L.hom≫L1_S.hom. This assertion involves only the first intersection projection, not the middle graph word or the second-neighborhood triangle.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphShrinkFirstLeg
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Z W : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ Z} (c : Compactification h)
    (H : EtaleGraphPresentation h) (a' : X ⟶ W) (v : W ⟶ H.U)
    [IsProper a'] [IsOpenImmersion v] (fac : a' ≫ v = H.a) :
    (H.graphIntersectionLeg₁ c A).hom ≫ (H.graphIntersectionShrinkIso c A a' v fac).hom =
      (H.graphFirstShrinkIso c A a' v fac).hom ≫
        ((H.shrink a' v fac).graphIntersectionLeg₁ c A).hom
